scenes.title: Cutscene P01 The unanswered bell
scenes.chapter: Prologue The Night the Sun Broke

timeline.text: TRIGGER: New game. CAMERA: Begin on the paper bird; follow it toward Aren crossing the square. AUDIO: Market chatter and the bell.

timeline.speaker: MIRA,
timeline.text: You’re late.

timeline.speaker: AREN
timeline.text: The bridge was crowded.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: You stopped to help someone.

timeline.speaker: AREN
timeline.text: That too.
The bell stops halfway through its next strike. Water hangs beneath the fountain. The paper bird freezes in the air. Veyr appears inside the Dawnheart’s light.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: No more departures. No more empty chairs. I can keep everything.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: You’re stopping the city’s heart.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: I’m keeping it from breaking.

scenes.title: Playable action P02 Reach the tower
scenes.chapter: Prologue The Night the Sun Broke

timeline.text: Give movement and dodge control to the unsplit Aren. Rescue two civilians from falling debris, climb the canal stairs, and fight three Stillborn sentries. The rescued civilians reappear in the ending. Mira unlocks the tower door while the player guards her. A visible circular warning teaches the same hazard language used throughout the game.

scenes.title: Cutscene P03 Four answers
scenes.chapter: Prologue The Night the Sun Broke

timeline.text: TRIGGER: Aren enters the sun chamber. Veyr removes four Dawn Seals from the central apparatus. Each seal vanishes toward a distant region.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: Aren, the core needs a living anchor!

timeline.speaker: AREN
timeline.text: Then use me.

Aren catches the falling heart of the sun against his chest. Veyr’s black lance strikes the core. Hold one frame of Aren’s silhouette; split it into four colored outlines. All four land in different corners of the chamber.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: Where did he go?

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: We’re asking the wrong question.

timeline.speaker: AZURE,
timeline.text: You’re hurt where I’m hurt.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: I remember saying yes.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: All four of you did.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Playable action P04 Escape together
scenes.chapter: Prologue The Night the Sun Broke

timeline.text: Teach switching or player ownership. Crimson clears rubble; Azure shields falling sparks; Gold redirects a broken door’s light; Violet reaches a release lever across a marked gap. Gates remain open once activated. Mira escapes with the party to a hillside beacon. Veyr withdraws into the eclipsed tower; he does not become a combat encounter here.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Arrival cutscene C01

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: Cut a path. Get them out.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: The roots are holding up the bridge.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: Cut those and we bury the people below.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: Then let’s find where the roots begin.
A wooden training dummy turns its head toward Crimson. A memory appears: young Aren charging past a fallen partner during a trial. The partner calls after him; the image breaks before Aren answers.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Resolution cutscene C02

timeline.text: Memory resumes. Young Aren finally turns, lifts the fallen partner, and loses the trial.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: I remembered running. I forgot why I stopped.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: You came back.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: Next time, I’ll look sooner.
The first seal lights the beacon. Briarhorn’s small wooden spirit rises and bows. Travelers resume walking; birds return to the trees.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Arrival cutscene C03

timeline.text: A survivor offers Azure a soaked blanket. All four recognize the stitched initials of Aren’s mother.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: I know this.

timeline.speaker: SURVIVOR
timeline.text: The abbey kept what people couldn’t carry.

timeline.speaker: SISTER NERETH,
timeline.text: Give me your pain. I will hold it until you feel nothing.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: And what happens to you?

timeline.speaker: NERETH
timeline.text: That stopped mattering long ago.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Resolution cutscene C04

timeline.speaker: NERETH
timeline.text: If I put it down, who will carry it?

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: You can ask.
CRIMSON kneels beside her. GOLD lifts the lantern. VIOLET opens the balcony gate.
A memory returns: Aren waiting beside his dying mother. He could not save her, but he stayed and held her hand.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: I thought remembering her meant remembering the moment I failed.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: We remember her laugh too.
The four share the memory. A brief laugh sounds beneath the first ordinary rainfall.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Cutscene C05 The fifth place at the fire

timeline.text: TRIGGER: Both first seals recovered. CAMERA: Four echoes around the fire; Mira sits beside a damaged sun diagram.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: Two seals. Two regions remaining. Then the core can restore our original configuration.
MIRA does not answer.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: Say it.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: The core can combine your bodies. I don’t know what it will do to the people you’ve become.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: People?

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: You remember different things now. You make different choices.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: But we’re Aren.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: Yes. That’s why I’m telling all of you.
Wind stirs the fire. Crimson turns away; Gold folds the diagram too precisely. Violet starts to speak, then stops.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: We get the seals first.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: And decide together.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Cutscene C06 Veyr remembers

timeline.text: TRIGGER: Leaving the refuge. CAMERA: The eclipsed tower. Veyr stands in a room preserved for his daughter, Elin. A spinning toy hangs still above her empty bed.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: They told me time would soften it.
He turns a cracked recording stone.

timeline.speaker: ELIN,
timeline.text: Again, Father. You skipped the best part.
The recording fails. Veyr reaches for the toy, but cannot bring himself to move it.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: There will be no next time. Nothing else will be taken.
A pulse of darkness crosses the land. Cut back to the four echoes seeing it from the road.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Arrival cutscene C07

timeline.text: GOLD reads a plan etched into the entrance.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: The route is complete. Stay behind me.
He steps onto a reflected stair. It vanishes. Azure catches him at the ledge.

timeline.speaker: GLASSWRIGHT,
timeline.text: An answer is only useful when nothing can change.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: Then why did your stairs move?
A laugh cracks into the sound of breaking glass.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Resolution cutscene C08

timeline.text: A memory shows Aren studying a rescue route while a burning bridge gives way. He abandons the perfect plan and follows the sound of someone calling.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: I didn’t know the bridge would hold.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: It didn’t.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: We crossed anyway.
The automaton’s eye returns as a small steady light.

timeline.speaker: GLASSWRIGHT
timeline.text: Tomorrow is unresolved.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: Then we should be ready to listen.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Arrival cutscene C09

timeline.text: VIOLET reaches a cliff shrine and finds four outlines carved into the stone. They surround one name: Aren.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: Maybe someone already knows how this ends.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: Or they’re recording how it started.
ASHWING lands above them, feathers trailing cold embers.

timeline.speaker: ASHWING
timeline.text: Every dawn becomes ash. Why climb?

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: Because—
She cannot finish. Ashwing spreads its wings and darkens the trail.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Resolution cutscene C10

timeline.text: A memory shows Aren as a child burying seeds after a fire. His mother works beside him.

timeline.speaker: YOUNG AREN
timeline.text: Will they grow?

timeline.speaker: MOTHER
timeline.text: Some might. Help me give them a chance.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET,
timeline.text: I’m afraid tomorrow will hurt too.

timeline.speaker: ASHWING
timeline.text: And still?
VIOLET lights the final seedling lamp.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: And still.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Cutscene C11 The return flight

timeline.text: TRIGGER: Four seals recovered. Ashwing carries the party toward Lumenfall. Restored waterways and forests pass beneath them, but the tower’s shadow continues to spread.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: When we get inside, he’ll try to divide us.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: He already did.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: He broke our body. He doesn’t get to choose what we do with it.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: Then let’s go home.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Cutscene C12 What reunion costs

timeline.text: Mira meets the party beside the Dawnheart controls.

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: With the seals here, I can draw you into one body.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: And our new memories?

timeline.speaker: MIRA
timeline.text: I can’t promise they’ll survive.
CRIMSON looks at the others rather than the machine.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: I used to think being whole meant needing nobody.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: I used to think it meant giving everything away.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: I wanted one answer.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: I wanted one that didn’t scare me.
A pause. All four place a hand against the control ring.

timeline.speaker: AREN,
timeline.text: We stay together. All of us.
Mira changes the circuit from Rejoin to Resonance. Four narrow paths of light appear around the central heart.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Final boss introduction C13

timeline.text: Veyr descends the tower stairs. His shadow moves before his body.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: Four voices. Four chances to lose yourself.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: Four chances to notice when we’re wrong.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: I could give you one life again.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: You could give everyone their lives back.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: And watch them suffer?
CRIMSON draws his sword. Violet raises her bow.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: You don’t get to decide that for them.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Transition F01
scenes.chapter: Final boss Stages One and Two

timeline.text: Veyr’s helmet falls. He sees his reflection repeated in the four echoes.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: I held the sun so carefully.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: You held it too tightly.
Veyr drives his lance into the core. Black light folds the walls outward.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: Then let the world see what I was holding back.
The chamber becomes an open ring over a motionless city. Veyr’s armor unfolds into a vast silhouette with an eclipsed sun in its chest.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Transition F02 The room beneath the shadow
scenes.chapter: Final boss Stage Three and ending

timeline.text: The four echoes stand in Elin’s preserved room, suspended inside the broken core. Veyr kneels beside the bed. The recorded voice skips again.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: If I let morning come, she’ll still be gone.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: Yes.
VEYR looks up, furious at the answer.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: And we’ll still remember her.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: But everyone outside this room is still living.

timeline.speaker: VEYR
timeline.text: I can’t.
He closes his hand. The room tears apart around the four.

scenes.status: dialogue and staging data; engine cutscene integration required

scenes.title: Final action F03
scenes.chapter: Final boss Stage Three and ending

timeline.text: Crimson cuts the lance. Azure catches Veyr’s falling body. Gold releases the seals from his shadow. Violet sends one lantern arrow into the Dawnheart. All four light paths join the shot.

timeline.speaker: AREN,
timeline.text: Let morning come.
The core ignites. Veyr’s shadow peels away in silent flakes. His hand opens. The broken recording plays one final clear sentence.

timeline.speaker: ELIN,
timeline.text: Again, Father. You skipped the best part.
Veyr smiles through tears, then dies as the shadow’s remaining light leaves him. Azure lowers him gently. The heroes defeat him; his grief is not magically erased.

scenes.title: Ending cutscene E01 Four footsteps
scenes.chapter: Final boss Stage Three and ending

timeline.text: CAMERA: Follow restored light through the five regions. Water falls from the fountain. The paper bird finishes its interrupted flight. The civilians saved in the prologue catch it.

timeline.speaker: MIRA,
timeline.text: Aren?

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: Here.

timeline.speaker: AZURE
timeline.text: Here.

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: Here.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: Still here.
MIRA laughs. “Good. We have work to do.”
Later, four echoes help rebuild the square. They stop at a new memorial bearing the names of those who did not return.

timeline.speaker: VIOLET
timeline.text: What do we do tomorrow?

timeline.speaker: GOLD
timeline.text: I have a few ideas.

timeline.speaker: CRIMSON
timeline.text: Tell us on the way.
AZURE lifts the paper bird from the ground and releases it. The four leave together. CUT TO TITLE: ECHOS OF LIGHT.
